title: Wespa host fixture page: 56px header, resizable sidebar, iframe mounted at ./?embed=1&theme=light with no inline script
description: `renderTestHostPage()` returns the host-fixture HTML as a pure string: HTML5 doctype, lang='en-GB', a 56px wespa-header carrying the Light/Dark toggle buttons, a resizable sidebar shell (data-rcf-host-sidebar + drag handle) and a content pane carrying `<iframe id="rcf-test-host-iframe" src="./?embed=1&theme=light">`. The fixture ships no inline `<script>` body (CSP-friendly, consistent with the PR 1 contract); its client-side wiring lives at /test-host.js (served via /test-host.js when the test-host route is enabled). The fixture does not persist theme or sidebar width to localStorage (ADR-4136): a passing run has to flip the iframe through the postMessage path, which is the invariant the fixture pins. Proves AC-206-1 (shell + iframe src + no inline script) and underwrites AC-206-6 (no outbound postMessage shape beyond the embed-client's single rcf-view-theme post).
